result.brief: 提出统一多模态世界模型 Thinker-WM，用共享 Unified Dynamics Transformer 在表征层统一 RGB、度量深度与机器人动作，支持联合视频-动作生成、世界预测与策略推断，并用运动探针验证冻结视觉表征含可恢复运动信息。
result.reason: Unified multimodal world model with shared dynamics representation across RGB, depth and action, plus motion probe on frozen visual features; directly targets world-model representation learning.
